newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco arrests Dutch, French nationals over drugs.
newsitem.headline: Morocco arrests Dutch, French nationals over drugs.

text.p: Morocco's anti-drug squad said on Thursday it had arrested three Dutch and four French nationals on drug charges in separate operations in the northern city of Tangier.
The French nationals were identified as Laurent Cazes, Alain Charles Houdart, Jean Pierre Noel and Henri Marcel Boutevilain, the official MAP news agency quoted police as saying.
The group was trying to smuggle out of Morocco more than 40 kg (88 pounds) of cannabis resin, MAP said.

The three Dutch -- Rodolf Egbert Edhart, Doerga Lilawatie and her daughter Dirghpal Aartie Angladebie -- were arrested with 114 kg (230 pounds) of cannabis hidden in the roof of their vehicle, it added.
A police spokeswoman said the group was arrested earlier this week but gave no more details. She said they are expected to appear before a court next week.
Morocco is spearheading a crackdown on drug smugglers with the aim to wiping out the traffic to the European market. Hundreds of foreigners have been arrested and jailed in the past few years.
